papers.title: Impact of Charge Trapping on the Energy Resolution of Ge Detectors for Rare-Event Physics Searches
papers.summary: Charge trapping degrades the energy resolution of germanium (Ge) detectors, which require to have increased experimental sensitivity in searching for dark matter and neutrinoless double-beta decay. We investigate the charge trapping processes utilizing nine planar detectors fabricated from USD-grown crystals with well-known net impurity levels.
